fidelity_limits: Scope is two completed evaluations on exactly one fixed structure and one fixed terminal weight; conclusions hold only at the tested points 0.075 and 0.15, never throughout the parameter range.

Holding maxima are sampled complete-evaluation statistics (final 0.05 s retained samples), not a continuous-time guarantee; real_time_demonstrated is false on all recorded runs and 35/35 deadline misses are expected.
Zero force_bound_violation_n does not exclude legal near-bound commanded input.

The two-checkpoint common-cold local preview at 0.20/0.30 s retains production early stops and horizons 10/5, is development data only, and may abstain; it carries no automatic rejection or screening reliability and never substitutes for full evaluation.

arguments.rationale: OBSERVATIONS (retained, source-bound). The selected passed incumbent is execution 91c3ba1b01d6499fb26df8f95409401b (candidate batch-ebbeadbdaca10732-0, configuration 285236abf99bf36894fa08410ac82fefa177a80179c4ceba15d95f8d1bc8d978), holding/terminal 0.05/0.05 on structure a609999274528b34741e5d29c1fc861d420d315c6585df26019c7dfc16d44c33, with holding_max_error_m 0.002730, holding_max_speed_m_s 0.012750, terminal_error_m 0.002698, joint_reach_holding_passed=true, valid_complete_execution=true, force_bound_violation_n 0.0. On the same structure, 0/0.05 (bebcfd47274940fb88a55ce5a2457c4c) also passes (0.002737, 0.012736, 0.002705) and 0.10/0.05 (110dc2c9c1d642dcb018664a65c62c30, latest tested) loses joint acceptance (holding_speed_passed=false, holding_max_speed_m_s 0.022129). These are completed evaluations; physical failure would remain usable evidence. HYPOTHESIS (proposed, unexecuted): on this frozen structure with terminal fixed at 0.05, holding weight 0.075 retains joint acceptance and 0.15 does not, placing the acceptance boundary in (0.05, 0.15]. PROPOSED TEST: two exact, genuinely unevaluated holding values, 0.075 and 0.15, chosen deliberately rather than for a favorable outcome; 0, 0.05 and 0.10 are excluded development points and are not re-run. 0.075 is the unweighted midpoint that interpolates the known pass (0.05) and known fail (0.10); 0.15 extrapolates one step beyond the highest evaluated holding weight to test whether degradation is monotone or plateaus. Exactly one varied path (control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight) per candidate, so each candidate dict contains only that path; list length is 2 and max_candidates=2, with step=null because this is an explicit finite sequence, and every candidate receives complete evaluation. Bounds [0.0,1.0] include the source point 0.05 and both proposed points and are the already authorized domain; both proposed values lie in [0.0001,1]. FIXED: robot (all undeclared structural fields), task, acceptance, controller_implementation, other_numerical_settings, structure (near 0.16 m, far 0.11 m, section_scale 0.95, compliant) and recipe family; terminal_tip_speed_weight stays 0.05; actuation, implementation, initializer, timing, solver and horizon are preserved. fixed_controller=controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0. SCOPE LIMITS: any statement that holding weight is ineffective or dominant is limited to the tested points on this one structure; a small unsuccessful batch only describes its tested candidates, and no physical improvement is claimed before execution. Scientific identities (accepted selection 91c3ba1b01d6499fb26df8f95409401b, latest tested 110dc2c9c1d642dcb018664a65c62c30, retained baseline cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef, and the two pending candidates) are distinct; the completed 0.05-vs-0 and 0.05-vs-0.10 comparisons are development data, never validation cases. stopping_conditions: Stop normally after both planned candidates have complete evaluation and profile reports (2 distinct changed configurations).
Stop immediately on unknown or material failure.
Stop if insufficient delivery capacity remains for full evaluation of a planned candidate.
Never exceed 2 backend attempts; do not add, replace, or re-weight candidates after feedback, and do not request further experiments after final interpretation.
Zero bound violation does not certify near-bound legality; raw termination and controller policy stops are recorded separately.
weakening_observations: On the fixed structure the historical joint-passing 0.05 differs only slightly from 0/0.05 (holding_max_error_m 0.002730 vs 0.002737; holding_max_speed_m_s 0.012750 vs 0.012736; terminal_error_m 0.002698 vs 0.002705), so any 0.075 effect is expected small and could be indistinguishable from the 0.05 point.

0.10/0.05 already loses joint acceptance on the same structure (holding_speed_passed=false, holding_max_speed_m_s 0.022129), so a favorable holding-weight effect is not monotone and may already be absent immediately above 0.05, making any predicted 0.075 retention fragile.

All six matched development intervals underestimated endpoint speed and missed the 1e-4 m/s tolerance, and the saved-state local preview produced zero correct direction/ranking predictions (four unresolved, no ordering match), so no preview is trusted for selection or screening reliability.

The recorded scientific warning shows a threshold-crossing misclassification at 0.31 s (predicted ~0.015943 m/s vs observed 0.022129 m/s across the 0.020 m/s limit): correct speed-change direction did not establish reliable classification, weakening confidence that any pre-run prediction of acceptance at 0.075 or 0.15 is trustworthy.
